links.outcome: LLM answers' alignment with expert consensus guidelines on ERAS ankle fracture management
links.effect: ChatGPT aligned with expert consensus in 29/35 (82.9%); iFlytek Spark in 22/35 (62.9%). Discrepancies in intraoperative blood pressure management and preoperative antiemetic selection.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated higher alignment with expert consensus (29/35 questions, 82.9%), particularly in comprehensive perioperative recommendations, detailed medical rationales, and structured treatment plans.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT and iFlytek Spark across 35 clinical questions related to ERAS-guided ankle fracture treatment, graded by orthopedic specialists for alignment with expert consensus. It evaluates LLM accuracy/consistency without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
